headline: US retail sales beat expectations in September as shoppers shrug off inflation
summary: US retail sales exceeded expectations in September as consumers continued spending despite ongoing inflation and higher gas prices.
why: Consumer spending accounts for the vast majority of US economic activity, serving as a primary indicator of overall economic health.

impacts.name: Retail
impacts.why: Stronger-than-expected sales figures support higher revenues for consumer goods and retail corporations.

why_moved: Resilient consumer demand surpassed consensus forecasts, alleviating immediate fears of a hard economic landing.
